relocations.name: reset_workram_copy

evidence.contract: Reset copies 3 << 15 words, incrementing source and destination by four; source [0x1000,0x61000) becomes work RAM [0x5a0000,0x600000). Original ROM PCs retain their displacement semantics when decoded at the guest RAM PC.

relocations.runtime_contract: RAM remains writable. Before each native relocated instruction executes, both live RAM instruction words must equal the verified program bytes; mismatch is a hard runtime error. No generic RAM-to-ROM alias is installed.
